description: Scan each edited .py, .ipynb, .R or .sql file for analysis and production slop; web files go through the Tastemaker scanner when installed. DMML_HOOK_MODE=block|warn|off.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py"
